description.en: A complete sauropod reconstruction with a relatively short neck and paired upper-body ridges. Forked neural spines are supported by bone evidence; their external soft-tissue covering, neck posture and colour are inferred.
description.zh: 完整蜥脚类复原，具有相对短颈和成对上躯脊线。分叉神经棘有骨骼证据，外部软组织包覆、颈姿态与颜色为推断。

diagnostic_targets: Relatively short neck: approximately half presacral column in Christian2002, rather than elongate Diplodocus neck.
Paired dorsal relief over posterior neck/shoulder-upper trunk follows bifid neural spines; modest flesh-covered ridges, not Amargasaurus spikes.
Broad deep torso, hindlimbs longer than forelimbs, shoulder lower than hip.
Small elongate blunt snout with restored-head uncertainty; avoid Camarasaurus box skull.
Full long tapering tail substantially longer than neck; four pillar-like limbs.

scale.basis: Approximate reconstruction scale based on Berlin mount horizontal13m in Wiedemann et al.1999 Table1, not curved axial/live length.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic living reconstruction using Berlin mounted skeleton. Head is a cast; mount includes restored anatomy and is not an untouched single skeleton.13m target is based on historical mount horizontal length reported in Wiedemann et al.1999 Table1, not live body length measured along a curved spine. NHM20m is a separate genus estimate, not applied here. Forked bony neural spines are evidenced, but their external soft-tissue ridge and colour are inferred; no claim exposed bare bones, tall horn sheaths or Amargasaurus-like giant spines. Life neck posture remains uncertain.
scientific_limits.zh: 依据柏林装架进行完整活体美术复原。头骨为铸模，装架含补配，并非原封单个体。13米目标依据Wiedemann等1999表1历史装架水平长度，非沿弯曲脊柱测量的活体长度；NHM20米为另一个属级估值，本模型不套用。分叉骨性神经棘有证据，体表双脊软组织形态与颜色为推断；不宣称裸露骨骼、巨角鞘或阿马加龙式超长棘。活体颈姿态仍有不确定性。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete sauropod with relatively short neck and paired/forked upper-body neural-spine ridge; original whole-organism target, not isolated spine or a renamed generic sauropod.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Berlin photos1999 and2021, plus1999 stereophotogrammetric Fig8/9; cast head explicitly identified in survey. No unsupported catalogue-number association.
